julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.title: Julier · Albula · Flüela Graubünden Triangle · short arc

waypoints.name: Chur fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Chur is where the day begins. Next is Lenzerheide balcony road, climbing 882 m.

waypoints.name: Lenzerheide balcony road
waypoints.advice: Lenzerheide balcony road comes up 53 km in. The road climbs 882 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 6 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Julierpass high road, climbing 809 m.

waypoints.name: Julierpass high road
waypoints.advice: 2284 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 809 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Albula Pass railway country.

waypoints.name: Albula Pass railway country
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 2315 m up. Reckon on about 12 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Flüelapass high section.

waypoints.name: Flüelapass high section
waypoints.advice: Flüelapass high section tops the climb at 2383 m. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Davos food and weather check, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Davos food and weather check
waypoints.advice: Davos food and weather check is where this day stops to eat. You lose 823 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 7 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Landquart return, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Landquart return gate
waypoints.advice: Landquart return closes the day. You lose 1037 m on the way down to it, steadily.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 36 km. 882 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: 75 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.story: 316 km one way from Chur - plan on about 6 h 04 of riding. The climbs: Julierpass high road, Albula Pass railway country and Flüelapass high section. It tops out at 2,383 m. Lenzerheide Pass, Albula Pass and Fluela Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.
